title: Micron HBM3E designed into AMD's Instinct MI350 AI chips

sources.quote: Micron announces the integration of our HBM3E 36GB 12-high offering into AMD's upcoming Instinct™ MI350X Series GPUs and platform.

explain: AMD uses Micron's 12-layer HBM3E high-bandwidth memory in its MI350 AI accelerators, making AMD a Micron memory customer. The value was not disclosed.
